intro: One translation add-on, one Streamer.bot action. Choose Manual, Automatic, or Both; results always return only to the platform where the message originated.

sections.title: 1. Choose how translation works
sections.description: Manual is the safest starting point. Both adds privacy-gated automatic translation.

sections.title: 2. Provider and languages
sections.description: The easy no-key option can detect the source language. The documented provider needs a fixed source language.
sections.notice: Recommended for easiest setup: Google web + source auto + target en. Google web is an undocumented consumer endpoint and may change without notice. MyMemory is documented but cannot use auto.

sections.title: 3. Manual commands
sections.description: !translate buenos dias uses the default output language. !translate fr hello and !fr hello override it.

sections.title: 4. Automatic translation
sections.description: Start with allowlist-only. Commands, bots, system messages, simulations, duplicates, and ignored viewers are always skipped.

sections.title: 5. Limits and spam protection
sections.description: These bounds protect Streamer.bot, the provider, and public chat.

sections.title: 6. Privacy review
sections.description: Translation cannot remain completely local with these providers.
sections.notice: Only eligible public chat text is sent over HTTPS. StreamBridge stores correlation and cooldown metadata but never stores source or translated messages. The provider may process text and request metadata. Never submit private or sensitive information.
